findings.affected_scope: lane-wide contract drift, not a defect unique to this package: 83/118 packages under docs/kf/*/kf_result.json carry the same top-level 'claims' key and only 7/118 validate. Remediation is a schema/convention decision (add 'claims' to the canonical root, or move it into outputs.claims) and belongs to the lane owner, not to package 01.
